integrity: Fully analytical proof using nonnegative Fourier-coefficient bound, a strict scalar inequality with exact integer certificates, and an explicit arithmetic-progression counterexample; finite checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Complex homogeneous polynomials; up to three prescribed monomials, degree at least four; optimal uniform cutoff at degree three is not determined; publication priority is provisional.
title: Degree four suffices for exact Bohnenblust–Hille contractivity on progression-free three-monomial supports
